map.CRC 不是单一算法，而是一族参数组合：多项式、初始值、是否反转输入/输出、结果: CRC is not a single algorithm but a family of parameter sets: polynomial, initial value, whether input/output is reflected, and the result xor value; changing any one of them changes the result. Common configurations include CRC-8, CRC-16/MODBUS, CRC-16/CCITT and CRC-32. You must confirm all parameters before comparing, not just the algorithm name.
map.CRC 检随机错很强，但不抗故意篡改（需密码学哈希）。: CRC is strong against random errors but does not resist deliberate tampering (use a cryptographic hash for that).
map.CRC 能检错但不能？: CRC can detect errors but cannot do what?
